result.diagnosis: Motion-too-flat in 7.0-9.8s (beat final-beat-03, phase final-beat-03:phase-focus, modality motion). Root cause: the phase declares purpose and duration (startSec 0, durationSec 2.8) but carries no camera params, so BeatCamera (EditVideo.tsx BeatCamera) falls back to the default requestedScale 1.12 and targetScale = Math.max(1.12, 1.12) = 1.12. The ramp is spread across the full beat (phaseEndFrame uses Math.round(beat.durationSec * fps) = 105 frames, not the phase end 84 frames), diluting the push. Additionally the HostReflectionShot treatment runs an internal counter-motion (push interpolates 1.06 -> 1.0 over the first 4s) that settles out while the camera pushes in, so the net perceived motion is near static. QA freeze evidence corroborates: diagnosis-master-v004.json reports three contiguous freeze events covering 7.43-9.3s in this exact window. Patch: give the phase a restrained cameraScale (1.2) that the renderer already consumes (phase.params.cameraScale); no dead params added. Post-run renderer note: the Kilo diagnosis was generated against v004 before the cameraPhaseFrames correction; final v009 now ends the camera ramp at the declared phase end (84 frames), and the after artifact points to the v009 render.
